NEW FILES:

- apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/host/stub.ex

HOST BEHAVIOUR (host.ex):
Define OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Host with @callback for each action currently in API.t()'s action fn-fields. The full list from api.ex: send_message, send_user_message, append_entry, get_model, set_model, get_thinking_level, set_thinking_level, abort, compact, get_system_prompt, get_active_tools, get_all_tools, set_active_tools, get_session_name, set_session_name, set_label, register_tool, exec, get_commands, get_context_usage.

Also define client-side API functions in the same module (not the behaviour callbacks -- these are the functions extensions call):
- Fire-and-forget actions (no return value needed): use GenServer.cast
  send_message/2, send_user_message/2, append_entry/2, set_model/2, set_thinking_level/2, compact/2, set_active_tools/2, set_session_name/2, set_label/2
- Query actions (return value needed): use GenServer.call
  get_model/1, get_thinking_level/1, get_system_prompt/1, get_active_tools/1, get_all_tools/1, get_session_name/1, get_commands/1, get_context_usage/1
- Special: abort/1 (cast), register_tool/2 (cast), exec/3 (call, returns result)

HOST.STUB (host/stub.ex):
GenServer that implements Host behaviour for tests. 
- start_link/1 takes initial config map: %{tools: [], commands: [], system_prompt: '', ...}
- Records all calls in order as [{action, args}] list
- Returns configurable responses for query actions (set via start_link config or update_config/2)
- Expose: Stub.calls(pid) -> [{action, args}], Stub.get(pid, key) -> value

NO existing files change in this ticket.

TEST: New test file host_test.exs. Test Host.Stub records calls, returns configured values, handles all actions without crashing.
